records.title: DeepMath-103K: A Large-Scale, Challenging, Decontaminated, and Verifiable Mathematical Dataset for Advancing Reasoning
records.reason: The primary text is a mathematical reasoning dataset and training/evaluation resource; it does not introduce an inference-system or serving efficiency technique despite the broad linked lineage.

records.title: MM1: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Multimodal LLM Pre-training

records.title: VAPO: Efficient and Reliable Reinforcement Learning for Advanced Reasoning Tasks
records.reason: The primary text proposes value-model-based reinforcement-learning training for long-CoT reasoning. Its efficiency claim concerns training steps/stability, not LLM inference or serving resources.
